TestCqlSession::test_data_integrity_with.description: 4 nodes in dc1 across 3 racks (2,1,1), RF=3 (tablets/vnodes per job). Writes 100 keys x 100 clustering rows at QUORUM (async, all futures awaited), verifies row counts at QUORUM. Then for each node in turn: kill it, verify all keys at QUORUM, write 1 new row to every existing key plus 25 new keys at QUORUM, restart the node (wait_other_notice), verify again. Guards against data loss / unavailability for QUORUM reads/writes during rolling hard node failures and restarts; verify_data retries up to 5x on Unavailable/ReadFailure.

origin.summary: Benny Halevy, 'Add cql_session_test' in PR 'Cql session: support multiple nodes' (also added multi-node support to dtest_setup._create_session); suite of gating tests for driver Session stability across node restarts.
